name: app-dark-project-facts-and-market-stat-cards
title: Dark case-study facts table with market stat tiles
whatItIs: A midnight-navy slide with an uppercase paragraph, a hairline table (industry, users, duration, project) and three dark cards showing market size with a donut ring, team avatars, and a growth arrow with percentage.
whatItMeans: Analytical and premium; the deep navy and lavender accents feel investor-ready.
techniques: Use hairline rules to build a spec table without boxes.
Set the abstract in large light uppercase.
Create stat cards with one graphic each (ring, avatars, arrow).
Keep contrast low with grey-blue text on navy and a single lavender accent.

vocabulary.definition: A list of label-value pairs separated by hairlines.
A circular progress chart with a centre value.
Grey text on dark for secondary info.
